source.title: Behavioral variability through stochastic choice and its gating by anterior cingulate cortex.

confidence_rationale: Causal circuit-perturbation evidence in transgenic rats that LOCUS COERULEUS (noradrenergic) input into ACC gates the switch between a strategic (model-based) mode and a STOCHASTIC (variable/exploratory) mode, and that the stochastic mode is engaged specifically under uncertainty about environmental rules (when counter-prediction cannot win) and otherwise suppressed. This is the single strongest anchor for the CDQ-002 refinement: the noradrenergic exploration signal is STATE-CONDITIONED (gated on uncontrollability/uncertainty) and SELF-ANNEALING (suppressed when a model-based strategy suffices). Causal (not merely correlational) and directly about the LC-NE -> action-variability pathway. Held at 0.82 for rodent->REE transfer and because 'stochastic mode' is a discrete gate rather than a graded per-parameter floor.
failure_signatures: If REE's tonic noise floor is implemented as an always-on, state-independent term (current MECH-313), it contradicts Tervo et al.: biologically the noradrenergic variability signal is GATED on environmental uncertainty/uncontrollability and suppressed when model-based strategy works, rather than applied uniformly.

Tervo's stochastic mode IGNORES action-outcome associations when engaged; a noise floor that perturbs selection without this gating could degrade exploitation in controllable regimes -- the REE falsifier must show the floor self-anneals where the policy is competent.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Rats switch from history/model-based strategies to a 'stochastic' choice mode when facing a competitor they cannot defeat by counter-prediction; in this mode action-outcome associations are ignored and ACC engagement is suppressed. Circuit perturbations show locus coeruleus (noradrenergic) input into ACC controls switching between strategic and stochastic modes; under uncertainty about environmental rules, changed noradrenergic input alters ACC output and prevents erroneous beliefs from guiding decisions, enabling behavioural variation.
mapping.ree_translation: The LC-NE -> ACC pathway is the biological controller for REE's MECH-313 tonic exploration floor. The paper grounds both CDQ-002 properties: state-conditioning (the variability signal is engaged by environmental uncertainty/uncontrollability) and self-annealing (it is suppressed when a model-based strategy is winning). This is the warrant for moving MECH-313 from a state-independent floor to a learned, state-dependent, self-annealing noise -- the NoisyNet analog -- and for the falsifier's requirement that the floor preserve, not wash out, committed behaviour in controllable regimes.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Tervo's 'stochastic mode' is studied as a competitive-game switch in rats and is closer to a discrete mode gate than to a graded per-parameter noise scale; the mapping to a continuously self-annealing sigma is an interpretation. Rodent->REE transfer risk applies, and the paper does not address the argmax-propagation question directly.
mapping.source_context: Transgenic rats, competitive matching-pennies-style task, optogenetic/chemogenetic circuit perturbation of the LC->ACC pathway.

confidence_components.notes: High source quality (Cell, causal circuit perturbation). High mapping fidelity: the LC-NE -> behavioural-variability gating is exactly the MECH-313 substrate, and the uncertainty-gating result maps cleanly onto state-conditioning + self-annealing. Transfer risk moderate-to-high (rodent competitive task -> REE selection).
